calculators.name: Room Floor Area Calculator
calculators.description: Calculates the floor area of a rectangular room from length and width measurements
assumptions: Measurements are taken from exterior dimensions
limitations: Does not account for irregular room shapes

calculators.name: Wall Net Area Calculator
calculators.description: Calculates the net wall area for a single wall with openings deductions
assumptions: No wall penetrations other than standard openings
limitations: Does not account for architectural projections/recesses

calculators.name: Masonry Brick Quantity Calculator
calculators.description: Calculates theoretical and procurement brick quantities from masonry volume
assumptions: Mortar joint applied uniformly on all six faces of each brick
No waste from cutting bricks to shape
